query: UPDATE job_item ji SET state = 'queued', lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, lease_epoch = lease_epoch + 1, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE ji.state IN ('leased', 'running', 'verifying') AND ji.lease_expires_at <= now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job j WHERE j.org_id = ji.org_id AND j.id = ji.job_id AND j.deletion_requested_at IS NOT NULL)
